tree_hash_method: sha256 over sorted 'relpath NUL sha256(file) LF' of every regular file under .cache/upstream/mdlzork (including .git)
shim: scripts/reference/fixed_time.c compiled once per capture: gcc -shared -fPIC -O2 -o fixed_time.so fixed_time.c -ldl; LD_PRELOAD, MDL_FIXED_EPOCH=<process epoch>, TZ=UTC
protocol: Each case repetition gets ONE fresh copy of the game directory under $TMPDIR; its processes run sequentially in that copy (B sees A's files). Pipe mode: all stdin (entry lines + commands, one per line) is written at once, then EOF. Fixed clock per process via LD_PRELOAD fixed_time.so (scripts/reference/fixed_time.c), MDL_FIXED_EPOCH=<epoch>, TZ=UTC. 'diagnostic_twin' cases are also run with diagnostic forms (READSTRING/RANDOM wrappers printing {{...}} markers to stdout); the twin's stdout with markers removed must equal the transcript run's stdout from 'Welcome to Dungeon.' on.
